eyQWuPfYDqHcvJN98vWFhw.en: WHO has officially declared the end of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Uganda. The country's last imported case was discharged on 16 July, and monitoring continued until 27 August, with 42 consecutive days without new cases. This outbreak recorded 20 confirmed cases cumulatively: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 local infections among contacts of imported cases and health workers; 18 recovered, 2 died, and more than 800 contacts were followed. Taiwan CDC lowered the travel advisory level for Uganda to 'no level' on 28 August.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

On 30 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Tshopo Province, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 31 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 3,674 (including 1,621 deaths and 666 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.1%. Its last locally confirmed case recovered and was discharged on 16 June, and no new locally acquired cases have been reported for 42 consecutive days since then. However, in line with international standards, the most recent imported patient was discharged on 16 July, and WHO began 42 days of follow-up monitoring from that date to ensure no transmission chains were missed. Given the continued expansion of the DRC outbreak and the cross-border transmission risk from population movement, Uganda may still face imported transmission and must maintain high-level surveillance and related control measures.

Authorities urge the public not to handle or eat the carcasses of animals that died of unknown causes, in order to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

1hnt0k2bi3ywo6hrPDfOfg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/11累計689例確定病例(139例死亡、32例康復),致死率(CFR)20.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共29個行政區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約28.4%。另過去24小時新增17例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中5例死亡。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/14累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。 WHO評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達以及與已記錄BDBV 檢出國家接壤的其他國家之風險為「高」,非洲其他地區以及全球之風險為「低」。
1hnt0k2bi3ywo6hrPDfOfg.en: The DRC has reported 689 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 11 June (139 deaths, 32 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 20.2%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 29 administrative areas, and the DRC's contact tracing rate is about 28.4%. In addition, 17 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province in the past 24 hours, of which 5 died. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 14 June, 19 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 5 recoveries), of which 14 were imported. WHO assesses the risk in the DRC as very high, the risk for Uganda and other countries bordering countries where BDBV has been detected as high, and the risk for other African countries and globally as low.

EXVaiKpz1ZW5BRi64qXj2g.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/9累計635例確定病例(127 例死亡、30例康復),致死率(CFR)20%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共26個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增37例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中12例死亡。另6/9發表之研究推估DRC截至5/27累計病例數介於280-2,520之間。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/10累計19例確定病例(2 例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
EXVaiKpz1ZW5BRi64qXj2g.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 9 June, 635 confirmed cases have been reported (127 deaths, 30 recovered), with a CFR of 20%. The outbreak is concentrated in 26 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 37 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province, of which 12 died. A study published on 9 June estimates DRC's cumulative case count as of 27 May at between 280 and 2,520. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 10 June it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.

FhkXIOrTCcwwvvjb024a5Q.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/8累計598例確定病例(115例死亡、22例康復),致死率19.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增48例確診病例(伊圖里省45例、北基伍省3例),其中14例死亡。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至6/9累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
FhkXIOrTCcwwvvjb024a5Q.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 8 June, 598 confirmed cases have been reported (115 deaths, 22 recovered), with a CFR of 19.2%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 48 new confirmed cases were added (45 in Ituri Province and 3 in North Kivu Province), of which 14 died. Uganda outbreak update: as of 9 June, it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.

WBipd1MxFRHR2dFk9lqbtg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/7累計550例確定病例(101例死亡、19例康復),致死率18.4%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約64.4%。過去 24 小時新增35例確診病例(伊圖里省31例、北基伍省4例),其中10例死亡。  WHO維持評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達及已確認BDBV檢出國家接壤之其他國家為「高」,非洲區域其餘國家及全球風險為「低」。
WBipd1MxFRHR2dFk9lqbtg.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 7 June, 550 confirmed cases have been reported (101 deaths, 19 recovered), with a CFR of 18.4%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 64.4%. In the past 24 hours, 35 new confirmed cases were added (31 in Ituri Province and 4 in North Kivu Province), of which 10 died. WHO maintains its risk assessment for DRC as very high, for Uganda and other countries bordering those where BDBV has been confirmed as high, and for the rest of the African region and globally as low.

_XeGLaqwz_R8n5GpQ_f1IQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/1 累計 344 例確定病例(60 例死亡、6 例康復),目前尚有 289 例待確定之疑病例,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 24 個衛生區。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 15 例確定病例 (1 例死亡),其中新增的 6 例病例均為確定個案之密切接觸者。 WHO 表示剛果民主共和國(DRC)近期疑病例數下降,此與疑病例經調查或檢測後被排除有關。
_XeGLaqwz_R8n5GpQ_f1IQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 1 June, 344 confirmed cases have been reported (60 deaths, 6 recovered), and 289 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 24 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda outbreak update: as of 2 June, it had 15 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death); the six newly added cases were all close contacts of confirmed cases. WHO said the number of suspected cases in DRC has recently declined, due to suspected cases being ruled out after investigation or testing.

iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/31累計321例確定病例(48例死亡、6例康復),目前尚有220例待確認之疑病例。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至5/31累計9確定病例 (1例死亡),個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 巴西報告2例疑病例,其中1例具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,經檢驗為流行性腦脊髓膜炎及瘧疾,已排除伊波拉病毒感染。
iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 31 May, 321 confirmed cases had been reported (48 deaths, 6 recovered), and 220 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. Uganda outbreak update: as of 31 May, 9 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death) had been reported, distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso District, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. Brazil reported two suspected cases; one had recent travel history to the DRC. Testing identified meningitis and malaria, and Ebola virus infection has been ruled out.

6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/30累計282例確診病例(42例死亡、2例康復),目前尚有321例待確認之疑病例。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共22個衛生區。另烏干達目前9例確診病例 (1例死亡)。 巴西當局於聖保羅與里約熱內盧監測2名伊波拉疑個案:案1為近期自DRC入境之DRC籍男性,案2為近期自烏干達入境之比利時籍男性。兩案雖已分別確診腦膜炎與瘧疾,惟尚未排除伊波拉病毒共感染之可能性,目前均已隔離並等待檢驗結果。 WHO秘書長譚德塞於5/30親赴DRC伊圖里省重災區視察,強調妥善治療可提高存活率。
6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 30 May, 282 confirmed cases (42 deaths, 2 recovered) had been reported, and 321 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda currently has nine confirmed cases (1 death). Brazilian authorities are monitoring two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: case 1 is a DRC national man who recently entered Brazil from the DRC, and case 2 is a Belgian man who recently entered from Uganda. Although they were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria respectively, Ebola virus co-infection has not been ruled out, and both are isolated awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hard-hit area of Ituri Province, DRC, on 30 May and stressed that proper treatment can improve survival.

ULj2saUhIIjkx-wC-Z0uuQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,截至5/28累計報告1,039例病例及242例死亡,分別為906例疑病例(其中223例疑死亡)、133例確診病例(其中19例確診死亡)。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省,並波及北基伍與南基伍省共13 個衛生區,其中Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu、Nyankunde個案數較多。此外,近期檢驗量能提升促使病例重新分類,致下修疑病例數,另位於Rwampara 的治療中心有首例治癒個案。烏干達確診病例增加至9例(其中1例死亡),個案分布於首都Kampala及Wakiso,與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 WHO於5/28建議3款治療藥物作為 (Bundibugyo virus disease,BVD)臨床試驗評估,並推薦1款口服抗病毒藥物作為暴露後預防之臨床試驗評估、以及2款候選疫苗作為開發評估。 WHO專家推測爆發疫情可能與DRC當地獵捕與食用野味習慣有關,另肯亞法院暫停美國專屬醫療設施計畫。
ULj2saUhIIjkx-wC-Z0uuQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 28 May, 1,039 cases and 242 deaths had been reported cumulatively, comprising 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths) and 133 confirmed cases (19 confirmed deaths). The outbreak is mainly concentrated in Ituri Province and has spread to 13 health zones in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces; Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Nyankunde have the most cases. Recent increases in testing capacity have led to reclassification of cases, which lowered the suspected case count. A first cured case has also been recorded at the treatment centre in Rwampara. Uganda's confirmed cases increased to nine (one death), distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. On 28 May, WHO recommended three therapeutic drugs for clinical trial evaluation in Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), one oral antiviral drug for clinical trial evaluation as post-exposure prophylaxis, and two candidate vaccines for development evaluation. WHO experts suspect the outbreak may be linked to local bushmeat hunting and consumption practices in the DRC. Separately, a Kenyan court has suspended a US-exclusive medical facility programme.

x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情急遽擴大,截至5/20累計報告近600例疑與139死亡病例,南蘇丹亦通報1例疑個案,跨國傳播風險驟升。由於目前DRC面臨武裝衝突、大量人口流離失所,加上檢體運送困難,當局表示可能嚴重低估通報病例數。另烏干達已宣布取消年度大型慶典「殉道者節」。
4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.en: The outbreak in the DRC and Uganda is expanding rapidly: as of 20 May, nearly 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan has also reported one suspected case, and the risk of cross-border spread has sharply increased. Because the DRC is facing armed conflict and mass displacement, and sample transport is difficult, authorities say case numbers may be seriously underreported. Uganda has also announced the cancellation of its annual major celebration, Martyrs' Day.

1mAaN_KF48TojEYpQDPn9g.zh: WHO於5/17宣布剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達發生由Bundibugyo病毒(BVD)感染引起之疫情為「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件」(PHEIC),惟尚未達「全球大流行緊急事件」(pandemic emergency)。DRC伊圖里省於5/5報告出現一種高致死率的不明原因疾病,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒造成此次疫情發生。首例已知病例為4/25出現症狀之醫護人員。伊圖里省截至5/16累計報告246例疑病例及80例死亡病例(疑),其中8例確診,已對接觸者進行追蹤調查。病例年齡介於20至39歲間,女性佔60%以上,主要分別於姆萬帕拉衛生區及蒙布瓦盧衛生區。 烏干達於5/15向WHO報告1例境外移入確診病例,為59歲DRC男性居民,5/11前往烏干達並於坎帕拉住院治療,5/14在加護病房中因出血症狀死亡,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒感染。該國坎帕拉於5/15-16累計報告2例確診病例(其中1例死亡),目前2者間無明確流行病學關聯,迄無證據顯示烏干達境內發生本土傳播。 本次疫情為DRC自1976年以來發生的第17次疫情,前一次疫情發生於2025年9/4-12/1,累計報告64例病例(53例確診)及45例死亡,前一次由Bundibugyo病毒造成之疫情發生於2012年8/17-11/26,累計報告59例病例(38例確診)及34例死亡。WHO評估本次疫情存在臨床警覺性低、多種病原共存、院內感染、地緣政治、追蹤困難及疫情已跨國傳播等複雜因素,並研判目前疫情主要集中於非洲特定地區,雖已有跨國個案,惟不建議實施旅遊或貿易限制,評估於國家及區域層級之公共衛生風險為高,於全球之風險則為低。
1mAaN_KF48TojEYpQDPn9g.en: On 17 May, WHO declared the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), but not a pandemic emergency. Ituri Province in the DRC reported an unexplained high-fatality illness on 5 May; on 15 May it was confirmed to be caused by Bundibugyo virus. The first known case was a health-care worker with symptom onset on 25 April. As of 16 May, Ituri had reported 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths, of which eight were confirmed, and contacts are being followed up. Cases were aged 20–39, with women making up more than 60%, and were mainly in Mwampala and Mongbwalu health zones. On 15 May, Uganda reported to WHO one imported confirmed case: a 59-year-old DRC male resident who travelled to Uganda on 11 May and was hospitalised in Kampala. He died of haemorrhagic symptoms in intensive care on 14 May, and BDBV infection was confirmed on 15 May. Kampala reported two confirmed cases cumulatively on 15–16 May, one of them fatal. There is no clear epidemiological link between the two, and there is no evidence of local transmission in Uganda. This is the 17th DRC outbreak since 1976. The previous outbreak ran from 4 September to 1 December 2025, with 64 cases (53 confirmed) and 45 deaths. The previous outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus ran from 17 August to 26 November 2012, with 59 cases (38 confirmed) and 34 deaths. WHO notes complex factors, including low clinical awareness, multiple pathogens circulating together, nosocomial infection, geopolitical issues, difficulties in contact tracing and cross-border spread. It assesses that the outbreak is currently concentrated in specific areas of Africa and, although there are cross-border cases, does not recommend travel or trade restrictions. WHO assesses the public health risk as high at national and regional levels and low globally.

Jck0sanvCqCNsPyfily28w.en: United States: As of 29 November this year, 1,798 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 212 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 46 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Poland: In the Carpathian Mountains region of south-eastern Poland, four counties reported a cumulative 18 cases as of 30 November this year, 8 of whom were hospitalized. Poland's first and second dose vaccination coverage is below the 95% recommended by WHO, and local community transmission is ongoing. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reported 3,051 cases in two health zones of North Kivu province from April to November, of which 1,111 developed severe complications. jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.

c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年5/29累計133國/地區報告14萬2,367例確診病例,其中至少325例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第22週累計74國/地區報告2萬1,655例確診病例,其中,非洲區1萬8,107例、美洲區1,787例、西太平洋區477例、歐洲區1218例、東南亞區37例及東地中海區29例。  其他更新:  非洲烏干達近幾週疫情呈下降趨勢,惟仍嚴峻,每週新增病例數約200例;蒲隆地每週新增病例數持續少於50例。WHO表示剛果民主共和國迄今仍為非洲疫情最嚴重之國家,由於檢測和確診能力下降,可能低報病例數,應審慎評估疫情趨勢。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。
c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.en: Monthly update: as of 29 May this year, 133 countries and regions have reported 142,367 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 325 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 22 this year, 74 countries and regions have reported 21,655 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 18,107 in the African Region, 1,787 in the Region of the Americas, 477 in the Western Pacific Region, 1,218 in the European Region, 37 in the South-East Asia Region and 29 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: in Africa, the outbreak in Uganda has declined in recent weeks but remains severe, with about 200 new cases per week; new weekly cases in Burundi have remained below 50. WHO says the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the most affected country in Africa; because testing and diagnostic capacity has declined, case numbers may be underreported, so trends should be assessed with caution. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

FsVDeFlrLbc73Bci9QtkWA.zh: 烏干達於4/26宣布疫情結束,自3/14最後1例確診蘇丹病毒疾病(SVD)患者檢測為陰性以來,已連續2個潛伏期(共42天)未通報新增病例。疫情於1/30宣布爆發後,截至疫情結束共報告14例,其中12例確診及4例死亡,病例來自該國7個地區,此次疫情為烏國第6次疫情,目前疫情雖已結束,惟當局仍持續保持監測,以備迅速應對未來可能再次發生之疫情,另疫情來源及範圍仍持續調查中。
FsVDeFlrLbc73Bci9QtkWA.en: Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on 26 April. Since the last confirmed Sudan virus disease (SVD) patient tested negative on 14 March, no new cases have been reported for two consecutive incubation periods (42 days in total). After the outbreak was declared on 30 January, 14 cases were reported by the end of the outbreak, of which 12 were confirmed and 4 died. Cases came from 7 districts in the country. This was Uganda's sixth outbreak. Although the outbreak has ended, authorities continue surveillance to be ready to respond rapidly if an outbreak recurs, and the source and scope of this outbreak are still under investigation.

DuEcjkm5pm5HntLbGe4KPQ.zh: 烏干達西部凱耶瓦爆發疫情,3/14報告新增1例確診病例與2例疑病例,指標病例為28歲男性,2/28出現症狀,3/7就診,與2例疑病例於相同院所隔離中,當局已主動監測並匡列接觸者。
DuEcjkm5pm5HntLbGe4KPQ.en: An outbreak has occurred in Kyegegwa in western Uganda. On 14 March, one new confirmed case and two suspected cases were reported. The index case is a 28-year-old man who developed symptoms on 28 February and sought care on 7 March; he was isolated at the same facility as the two suspected cases. Authorities have begun active surveillance and are tracing contacts.

AxG9-7zkNPog70p_KXJc3g.zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,3/3-6新增報告2例確診病例,自1/30截至3/6累計14例病例,其中12例確診,累計4例死亡(2例確診;CFR:16%),評估該地區病毒傳播風險持續存在,當局於3/6新匡列69位接觸者,並加強監測。
AxG9-7zkNPog70p_KXJc3g.en: Kampala, Uganda update: 2 new confirmed cases were reported between 3 and 6 March. From 30 January to 6 March, 14 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 12 were confirmed, with 4 deaths cumulatively (2 confirmed; CFR: 16%). Assessment: the virus transmission risk in the area persists. On 6 March, authorities listed 69 new contacts and strengthened surveillance.

3ec1KXG8fkaObjSzSH4PfA.zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,3/1-3新增報告2例疑死亡病例,自1/30截至3/3累計12例病例,其中10確診,累計4例死亡(2例確診; CFR:20%),其中,案10(4歲男童)於2/15求診,24日死亡,其後回溯發現其母親與弟弟可能為疑案例,其母親(案11)於1/23產子,2/6因急性病症死亡,該新生兒(案12)約1週後死亡,2位疑病例皆未採檢且已埋葬,評估該地區病毒傳播風險持續存在,當局於3/2重新匡列201位接觸者,並加強監測。
3ec1KXG8fkaObjSzSH4PfA.en: Kampala, Uganda update: between 1 and 3 March, 2 suspected deaths were newly reported. From 30 January to 3 March, 12 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 10 were confirmed, with 4 deaths cumulatively (2 confirmed; CFR: 20%). Case 10, a 4-year-old boy, sought care on 15 February and died on 24 February. On later investigation, his mother and younger brother were found to be possible suspected cases. His mother (case 11) gave birth on 23 January and died on 6 February of an acute illness; the newborn (case 12) died about a week later. Neither suspected case was sampled, and both had already been buried. Assessment: the virus transmission risk in the area persists. On 2 March, authorities re-listed 201 contacts and strengthened surveillance.

o1B4HqriVINbwSbMtM30NA.zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,公布自2/7-3/1新增1例死亡病例,自1月中旬截至3/1累計10例確診病例,其中2例死亡(CFR:20%),餘8例確診者已於2/18-19康復出院。新增1例死亡病患為四歲半兒童,於2/25因症就診後死亡,顯示病毒仍在傳播,該國已恢復更積極因應措施。
o1B4HqriVINbwSbMtM30NA.en: Kampala, Uganda update: between 7 February and 1 March, one new death was reported. From mid-January to 1 March, 10 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 2 died (CFR: 20%); the other 8 confirmed cases recovered and were discharged on 18–19 February. The new death was a 41⁄2-year-old child who sought care on 25 February and died afterwards, showing that the virus is still spreading. The country has resumed more intensive response measures.

_RoRKtstM1wt8E2CqwfHaA.zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,自1月中旬截至2/9,累計5地區報告9例(增加2例)確診病例,其中1例死亡(CFR:11.1%),病患分布於瓦基索4例、坎帕拉2例、姆巴萊/金賈/穆科諾各1例。截至2/18,8例確診病例已出院,其餘216名接觸者仍在隔離中。當局自2/3進行全球首次疫苗臨床試驗。
_RoRKtstM1wt8E2CqwfHaA.en: Kampala, Uganda update: from mid-January to 9 February, 9 confirmed cases (2 newly added) were reported cumulatively in 5 areas, of which 1 died (CFR: 11.1%). Patients were distributed as follows: 4 in Wakiso, 2 in Kampala, and 1 each in Mbale, Jinja and Mukono. As of 18 February, 8 confirmed cases had been discharged, and 216 contacts remained in quarantine. Authorities began the world's first clinical trial of a vaccine on 3 February.

YCi4PEDbBqaUi5oOooh7Uw.zh: 烏干達坎帕拉疫情更新,自1月中旬截至2/7,累計報告7例(增加5例)確診病例、其中1例死亡(CFR:14.3%),指標病例為32歲男性護理人員,於1/20發病後,1/29死亡,案2為案1之妻子,案1生前曾於姆巴萊區的傳統治療所及3個醫療機構就診,後死於首都坎帕拉。目前已知有兩條傳播鏈,分別為親友與醫護機構群,當局已匡列298位接觸者,其中11位親友、34位醫護人員。
YCi4PEDbBqaUi5oOooh7Uw.en: Kampala, Uganda update: from mid-January to 7 February, 7 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (5 newly added), of which 1 died (CFR: 14.3%). The index case was a 32-year-old male nurse who developed symptoms on 20 January and died on 29 January. Case 2 was his wife. Before he died, the index case had visited a traditional healing centre in Mbale District and three healthcare facilities, and he died in Kampala. Two transmission chains are now known: one among relatives and friends, and one in a healthcare facility cluster. Authorities have listed 298 contacts, including 11 relatives and friends and 34 healthcare workers.

O9V5bJqjBQyD5YQfJN6Elg.zh: 烏干達近期疫情上升且嚴峻,自今年迄今已有3例輸出病例至英國,皆為Ib型,依據WHO統計自2024/7/29截至2025/1/17已有2,031例確診病例,其中10例死亡(CFR:0.4%),疫情主要在坎帕拉。 獅子山於今年1/11報告該國首例確診,為IIb分支型病例。截自1/26累計7省16例確診。病患中有10例為男性,年齡範圍為1-52歲,其中1例為醫護人員,當局已匡列293位接觸者。
O9V5bJqjBQyD5YQfJN6Elg.en: Uganda: The outbreak has risen and is severe. Since the start of this year, three exported cases, all clade Ib, have been reported to the United Kingdom. According to WHO, from 29 July 2024 to 17 January 2025, 2,031 confirmed cases were reported, including 10 deaths (CFR 0.4%); the outbreak is mainly in Kampala. Sierra Leone: On 11 January this year, the country reported its first confirmed case, a clade IIb case. As of 26 January, 16 confirmed cases had been reported in seven provinces. Ten of the patients are male, aged 1–52 years, and one is a healthcare worker. Authorities have listed 293 contacts.

hUTWs1PUhJVbDXmniirm4A.zh: 烏干達衛生部於1/30宣布爆發疫情,病患為32歲男性護理人員,1/20-1/21出現發燒、胸痛及呼吸困難等症狀,隨後出現不明原因之體內外出血,1/29轉院後死亡,死後經檢驗感染蘇丹病毒確診,目前已確認45名接觸者,包含34名醫護人員及11名家庭接觸者。蘇丹病毒於1976年首次發現以來已爆發8次疫情,其中5次於烏干達,最近一次於2023/1/11宣布結束,當時報告164例病例及77例死亡。WHO表示目前尚無批准之疫苗及治療藥物,SVD可能造成公衛嚴重影響,當地社區對防護感染措施有限,可能存在多條傳播鏈,該國持續疫調,以確定疫情範圍,不排除已傳播至周邊地區及其他國家的可能。
hUTWs1PUhJVbDXmniirm4A.en: On 30 January, Uganda's Ministry of Health announced an outbreak. The patient is a 32-year-old male nurse who developed fever, chest pain and difficulty breathing on 20–21 January, followed by internal and external bleeding of unknown cause; he was transferred and died on 29 January. After death, testing confirmed Sudan virus infection. So far 45 contacts have been identified, including 34 healthcare workers and 11 household contacts. Since Sudan virus was first identified in 1976, eight outbreaks have occurred, five of them in Uganda; the most recent, declared over on 11 January 2023, reported 164 cases and 77 deaths. WHO notes that no vaccine or treatment is currently approved, that SVD may have a serious public health impact, that community protective measures against infection are limited, and that multiple transmission chains may exist. The country continues epidemiological investigation to define the extent of the outbreak; spread to surrounding areas and other countries cannot be ruled out.

WQ0Xjp1zXbzHlL2ywn6AOw.zh: 烏干達中部穆本德地區1/10報告新增1例確診、3例疑病例,確診病患為45歲男性農民,有牛、羊隻接觸史,症狀包含發燒、喉嚨痛及自發性出血,當局已加強衛生與個案管理。去年該國五地區累計20例病例,其中8例確診,4例死亡。
WQ0Xjp1zXbzHlL2ywn6AOw.en: In Mubende region, central Uganda, one new confirmed case and three suspected cases were reported on 10 January. The confirmed patient is a 45-year-old male farmer with contact with cattle and goats, with symptoms including fever, sore throat and spontaneous bleeding. Authorities have strengthened health measures and case management. Last year the country reported 20 cases cumulatively across five regions, of which 8 were confirmed and 4 died.

mXC_rdG5Sve-fv7PV2mdog.zh: 非洲報告自2024年初截至52週累計3國共294例病例,其中42例確診,8例死亡;分別是烏干達277例病例,6例死亡、剛果民主共和國10例病例(2例死亡)及肯亞7例病例(無人死亡),WHO評估傳播風險為中,當局呼籲加強監測與妥善處理動物遺體。
mXC_rdG5Sve-fv7PV2mdog.en: Africa reported 294 cases cumulatively from early 2024 to week 52 across three countries, including 42 confirmed and 8 deaths: Uganda 277 cases and 6 deaths, the Democratic Republic of the Congo 10 cases (2 deaths), and Kenya 7 cases (no deaths). WHO assesses the transmission risk as moderate. Authorities urge strengthened surveillance and proper handling of animal carcasses.

ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.zh: 東非蘇丹疫情嚴峻,去年12/3已知感染病例達48,000例,其中18%正在接受治療,另12/23報載南蘇丹瓊萊州產前檢查陽性孕婦人數亦明顯上升,推測社會動盪及缺乏醫療資源應為當地疫情上升主因;烏干達去年全國盛行率約5.1%,其中,卡蘭加拉區較為嚴峻,盛行率約12.8%,惟近年已有明顯下降。
ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.en: The HIV situation in Sudan in East Africa is severe: as of 3 December 2024, 48,000 known infections had been recorded, and 18% of them were receiving treatment. Media reported on 23 December that the number of pregnant women testing positive at antenatal screening in Jonglei State, South Sudan, had also risen markedly. The rise is presumed to be mainly due to social unrest and a lack of medical resources. Uganda's national prevalence in 2024 was about 5.1%; Kalangala District is more severe, with a prevalence of about 12.8%, although it has declined markedly in recent years.

AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年截至11/30累計1,138例病例,其中41例確診,7例死亡,病例分布於剛果 (452例)、中非共和國(390例)、加彭(146例)、南蘇丹(139例)、喀麥隆(8例)、幾內亞(2例)及烏干達(1例)。
AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至12/16累計20國報告65,947例病例,其中14,394例確診,1,239例死亡(CFR:1.88%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,533例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,402例次之,烏干達925例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC 12/19表示,預計下週取得首批5萬劑LC16疫苗,2月起並將陸續到貨300萬劑,該疫苗可用於1歲以上兒童,可填補目前兒童疫苗接種無法涵蓋之族群。
5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 16 December this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 65,947 cases cumulatively, including 14,394 confirmed and 1,239 deaths (CFR 1.88%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,533 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected; Burundi, with 2,402 cases, ranks second, and Uganda, with 925 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated on 19 December that it expects to receive the first 50,000 doses of LC16 vaccine the following week, with 3 million doses to arrive in batches from February. The vaccine can be used in children over one year old, filling a gap in populations not covered by current childhood vaccination.

bwnrf7hiCy57x8T14e-VJQ.zh: 烏干達西部大區卡左區於12/12新增2例死亡病例,病患均為屠宰人員,並於食用受汙染肉品約5日後發病,當局呼籲民眾避免食用來源不明肉品。
bwnrf7hiCy57x8T14e-VJQ.en: In Kazo district of Western Region, Uganda, two new deaths were reported on 12 December. Both patients were slaughterhouse workers who fell ill about five days after eating contaminated meat. Authorities urge people to avoid eating meat of unknown origin.

Hqxm_LoYSKmQ37Zau5Hq4Q.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/29累計20國報告62,789例病例,其中13,848例確診,1,204例死亡(CFR:1.85%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,158例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,392例次之,烏干達784例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC表示,上週新增病例數顯著增加,仍以剛果民主共和國為多,另自7月中旬以來,Ib型的檢出量持續穩定上升。
Hqxm_LoYSKmQ37Zau5Hq4Q.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 29 November this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 62,789 cases cumulatively, including 13,848 confirmed and 1,204 deaths (CFR 1.85%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,158 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected, followed by Burundi with 2,392 cases; Uganda, with 784 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated that case numbers rose significantly last week, still concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; since mid-July, detections of clade Ib have continued to rise steadily.

PfX_cXkLw2NZqgehL4Bfgw.zh: 烏干達疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告20例病例,7例死亡,病例分布於5個地區。 塞內加爾今年迄今累計報告7例病例,無死亡病例,病例分布於5個衛生區,當局已在受影響地區進行防治活動。
PfX_cXkLw2NZqgehL4Bfgw.en:
Uganda update: So far this year, 20 cases and 7 deaths have been cumulatively reported, with cases distributed across 5 areas.

Senegal update: So far this year, 7 cases have been cumulatively reported, with no deaths. Cases are distributed across 5 health districts, and authorities have carried out prevention and control activities in affected areas.

Tz8N6ryupaUilUUT7EpaRw.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/8累計20國報告55,413例病例,其中12,162例確診,1,142例死亡(CFR:2.06%),以剛果民主共和國報告9,456例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地1,834例次之,烏干達443例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 加拿大曼托巴省11/22報告該國首例Ib型病例,個案近期有非洲流行國家旅遊史,目前隔離中,並進行接觸者追蹤,評估對一般民眾的風險仍低。
Tz8N6ryupaUilUUT7EpaRw.en:
According to Africa CDC, across Africa as of 8 November this year, 20 countries have cumulatively reported 55,413 cases, including 12,162 confirmed cases and 1,142 deaths (CFR: 2.06%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, reporting 9,456 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,834 cases. Uganda, with 443 cases, has seen a marked rise in its outbreak, and the remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each.

Manitoba Province, Canada, reported the country's first clade Ib case on 22 November. The patient had recently travelled to an African country with ongoing outbreaks, is in isolation, and contacts are being traced. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low.

8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.zh: 美國加州11/16報告首例第I型病例,病患具非洲旅遊史,目前於家中隔離,當局已追蹤相關接觸者,迄無持續傳播跡象。 非洲Ib型疫情持續,其中剛果民主共和國、蒲隆地原多係透過年輕人性接觸傳播,惟隨感染族群擴大,已轉為家庭及社區傳播,幼兒感染比例亦上升;烏干達近期疫情明顯上升,多係透過性接觸感染。 ACDC 11/6已與生技公司合作,啟動天花藥物 brincidofovir (TEMBEXA)用於治療M痘之相關試驗。
8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.en:
California, United States, reported its first clade I case on 16 November. The patient had travel history to Africa and is isolated at home. Authorities have traced related contacts, and there are no signs of ongoing transmission so far.

Clade Ib outbreaks continue in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Burundi, transmission was originally mostly through sexual contact among young people; as the affected population has expanded, transmission has shifted to household and community spread, and the proportion of young children infected has also risen. In Uganda, the outbreak has risen markedly recently, with infection mostly through sexual contact.

Africa CDC, on 6 November, worked with a biotechnology company to launch trials of the smallpox drug brincidofovir (TEMBEXA) for treating Mpox.

5F21bFTIiCXZHD0tR_ZdIQ.zh: 烏干達卡左區(Kazo)11/8報告群聚感染事件,累計報告5例病例,皆已隔離治療,該些病患均曾屠宰一頭死亡牛隻。 孟加拉中部拉傑沙希專區諾多爾縣10月爆發群聚感染事件,迄今累計報告12例病例,當地近2個月曾出現牛隻及山羊疫情,推測本次群聚事件為食用或屠宰感染動物所致,當局已加強牲畜疫苗接種。
5F21bFTIiCXZHD0tR_ZdIQ.en:
In the Kazo area of Uganda, a cluster was reported on 8 November with 5 cumulative cases, all isolated for treatment. All of these patients had slaughtered a dead cow.

In Natore District, Rajshahi Division, central Bangladesh, a cluster outbreak began in October, with 12 cumulative cases reported so far. Cattle and goat outbreaks have occurred in the area in the past two months. The cluster is presumed to be due to eating or slaughtering infected animals, and authorities have stepped up livestock vaccination.

9QZkayQQV1T4kXLuVN340Q.zh: 烏干達9月底起疫情上升,今年截至10/22累計11(/146)地區報告251例病例,其中29例確診,確診病例中有6例死亡,至少50%病例分布於西南部卡農古區,當局已加強該區之動物疫苗接種措施。
9QZkayQQV1T4kXLuVN340Q.en: Anthrax has been rising in Uganda since late September. As of 22 October this year, 251 cases have been cumulatively reported from 11 (of 146) districts, of which 29 were confirmed; 6 of the confirmed cases died. At least 50% of cases are in Kanungu District in the southwest, where authorities have stepped up animal vaccination.

dDHvpKJSm8SL2SOEONeYRg.zh: 烏干達西南部卡農古區9月底爆發疫情,單週新增報告59例病例,其中2例確診,1例死亡;今年截至9月底累計6行政區報告185例確診,4例死亡。當局已加強防治措施及動物疫苗接種。
dDHvpKJSm8SL2SOEONeYRg.en: An outbreak occurred in Kanungu district in southwestern Uganda in late September. In a single week, 59 cases were reported, of which 2 were confirmed and 1 died. This year, cumulatively to the end of September, 6 administrative districts have reported 185 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Authorities have strengthened control measures and animal vaccination.
